scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres && sleep 4 && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.api:generate: pnpm build:contracts && pnpm openapi && pnpm sdk
scripts.dev: pnpm build:contracts && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.build: pnpm build:contracts && pnpm --filter @gp/api build && pnpm --filter @gp/web build
scripts.lint: eslint apps packages tests e2e tools --max-warnings 0
scripts.gate: pnpm api:generate && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint:spec && pnpm lint:slices && pnpm lint:design-system && pnpm lint:architecture && pnpm test && pnpm test:storybook && pnpm storybook:build && pnpm build
scripts.gate:full: pnpm gate && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed && pnpm smoke && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && pnpm db:up && sleep 4 && pnpm build:contracts && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed && pnpm api:generate
